the temperature dependence of refractive index and linear expansion coefficient of laser glasses and laser garnets are very similar to the temperature dependence of those parameters for silica glass.

the linear expansion coefficient of laser glasses and laser garnets is 1.5–3 times larger than that of silica, and the temperature coefficient of refractive index of these glasses is 2–3 times greater.
